According to Wikipedia, "Rodri is the current holder of the award, having won its most recent edition in 2024" [d2], while ESPN confirmed he was awarded the prize "after a stellar season that saw him pick up silverware with both club and country," including the Premier League and Euro 2024 [d8]. Rodri became the second Spanish-born men's player to win the award and the first since Luis Suárez in 1960 [d8][d10]. In the women's category, Aitana Bonmatí won the Ballon d'Or Féminin for a second consecutive year in 2024 [d3][d5].
